name: Pi-hole
description: Network-wide ad blocker and DNS sinkhole that protects all devices on your network from ads and trackers.

env.label: Admin Password
env.description: Password for the Pi-hole v6 admin dashboard (replaces legacy WEBPASSWORD)

env.label: Admin Password (legacy)
env.description: Legacy v5 admin password variable; ignored on Pi-hole v6. Use Admin Password above.

env.label: Upstream DNS Servers
env.description: Upstream DNS servers separated by semicolons (e.g. 8.8.8.8;8.8.4.4, 1.1.1.1;1.0.0.1)

env.label: DNSSEC
env.description: Enable DNSSEC validation (requires compatible upstream DNS)

env.label: Local IPv4 Address
env.description: Set to your server's LAN IP address for proper blocking page display

env.label: Virtual Host
env.description: Hostname/IP of your Pi-hole instance for admin access (e.g. pi.hole)

env.label: DNS Listening Mode
env.description: Listening behavior: local (recommended), all, or single interface
